title: Cap. X Arg. V open: to be given and not given to Christ is to be ordained or not ordained unto eternal life by predestination and preterition — and that distinction of given/not-given precedes our believing and not believing
pass_a_gloss: To be given and not to be given unto Christ is by predestination and preterition to be ordained or not ordained unto everlasting life: But this discrimination of those given and not given precedes our believing and not believing, persevering or not persevering.
pass_b_english: To be given to Christ, and not to be given to him, is — by predestination and preterition — to be ordained, or not ordained, unto everlasting life. That distinction between those given and those not given comes before our believing and not believing, before our persevering or failing to persevere.
source_text: Dari et non dari Christo est per praedestinationem et praeteritionem ordinari aut non ordinari in vitam aeternam: At haec datorum et non datorum distinctio antecedit nostrum credere et non credere, perseverare aut non perseverare.
